pages.text:
Princess Iron Fan has a new flower box
full of red flowers.
Wukong has borrowed Little Bean and its
square mat from Nezha.
Iron Fan sets her flower box right on the
four middle squares.
Around it, there is one ring of squares.
2

“Let’s give my flowers a little parade!”
says Iron Fan.
Little Bean will roll all the way around
the flower box, so that it comes back to
its corner.
Wukong puts the robot in the bottom
corner, facing up, just as Nezha does.
3

Each side of the ring is three
squares long.
So Wukong lays out forward, forward,
forward and turn right.
“These four cards will take Little Bean to
the first corner,” he says.
Then he lays the same four cards again
for the next side.
4

Wukong keeps going, but after ten cards,
there are no forward cards left.
The third side still needs a forward card
and a turn right card.
The last side needs four more cards.
“The whole way round needs sixteen
cards!” says Wukong.
5

“Let me help!” says Iron Fan.
“We can draw six more cards on paper.”
But Chang’e is looking at the long row
very carefully.
She notices that the same cards keep
coming back again and again.
6

“Look at this,” says Chang’e. “Forward,
forward, forward, turn right.
These four cards repeat again and again.”
She points to the first group of four and
then to the second group.
Every side of the ring uses the same
four steps.
7

Chang’e draws a loop arrow and the
number four on a long blank card.
“This card means repeat four times,”
she says.
She puts the four arrow cards on top of
it in a row.
Now the program needs five cards,
not sixteen.
8

Little Bean has no repeat button, so the
friends follow the card themselves.
Wukong presses forward three times,
then turn right, then go.
Little Bean rolls three squares up the left
side and turns right at the corner.
“That is one time!” says Iron Fan.
9

Wukong presses the same steps and
go again.
This time, Little Bean rolls along the far
side, behind the flowers.
It turns right when it reaches the
next corner.
“That is two times,” says Chang’e, and she
holds up two fingers.
10

The third time, Little Bean rolls down the
right side, past the red flowers.
It turns right at the corner near Iron
Fan’s feet.
All three friends shout, “Three times!”
Now there is only one side left to go.
11

The fourth time, Little Bean rolls along
the front side and back to its
starting corner.
When it turns right and stops, it is facing
up, just like at the start.
The flower parade went all the
way around!
Iron Fan claps and spins.
12

“Now let’s do a robot dance!” says
Iron Fan.
Wukong draws two new cards, one for
clap and one for turn around.
Chang’e makes another repeat card with
the number three.
“Clap, turn around, and repeat three
times,” reads Wukong.
13

The three friends stand in a row and
follow the cards like robots.
They clap and turn around, then clap and
turn around again.
When they finish each time, Wukong
counts out loud.
After the third time, they all stop and
stand very still.
14

“Again, again!” says Iron Fan, because she
does not want to stop.
So they follow the dance cards one
more time.
Now they have clapped six times and
turned around six times.
Wukong is so dizzy that he sits down
and laughs.
15

Before Wukong goes home, Little Bean
does one last parade for the flowers.
This time, Wukong puts out the five cards
right away.
“When the steps repeat,” he says, “I can
use a repeat card!”
16
